algorithm.description: 2D five-point Jacobi solver, fixed sinusoidal boundary, interior 0, iterate until sqrt(sum(df^2)/(N*N)) <= tol

timing_scope: wall time of the full convergence while-loop / iteration count (HeCBench reference scope); warm-up excluded, measured solves independent
warmup: 1 untimed solve, then >=5 independent measured solves; median reported

validation.host_reference: independent double-precision five-point solver in src/helper.hpp
validation.tolerance_rationale: float solution magnitude <= 1, one float ulp near 1 is 5.96e-8; worst observed residual 7.12e-7 at N=2048; tolerance keeps ~140x margin, not widened to hide bugs

runs.note: one invocation captured for the final kernel; the same source passed all size validations afterwards
